column1: # Apps installed on first boot by Edge1 Tools (device/khadas/edge/apps/Edge1Tools).
#   1. The apks folder: D:\android_khadas\apks on Windows (or ~/android_khadas/apks
#      in WSL, or EDGE1_APKS_DIR). Every .apk in it goes onto the image as it is.
#      This is the way to add anything - Projectivy, SmartTube, LazyMedia Deluxe ...
#   2. This list: apps downloaded from F-Droid and nowhere else, checked against
#      F-Droid's signed index. An entry is skipped when the folder already has a
#      file named like it (or starting with its name: VLC-Android-3.6.5.apk for VLC).
# Columns, tab-separated: name <TAB> F-Droid package name
# Nothing here changes the default launcher: a launcher among the apps is chosen
# with the "Default launcher" button in Edge1 Tools.
